title: trailboss --json until
description: One JSON object per line while the loop runs: one per round (a check run after a finished turn), plus a line when the failure has to wait to be typed and a last line when it stops between rounds. Every line has every field. The check's output and the message typed are never in the output. Exit code 0 on a pass, 1 otherwise.

round.description: Checks run so far (this line's round, for a round line).

passed.description: Whether the check passed; null on a line that isn't a round (a stop between rounds, or waiting to send).

exit_code.description: The check's exit code; null when not a round or killed by a signal.

files_changed.description: Whether the session's folder changed since the check before; null when unknown (not a git work tree, or checked before the agent's first turn).

cost_usd.description: Dollars the session has spent since the loop started.

minutes.description: Minutes the loop has run, not counting quota pauses.

paused_until.description: The plan's quota is used up: the loop waits until this time (seconds since the epoch) before typing.

waiting_to_send.description: Why the failure isn't typed yet (the agent isn't ready); tried again on every look. Said once per reason.

stopped.description: Why the loop ended, on its last line: passed, max_rounds, max_cost, max_time, same_failure, no_changes, session_ended or check_error. null while it goes on.

reason.description: The stop in a person's words.
